integrity: The unweighted wheel covering-ellipsoid case and established graph-optimal-design principles are credited as prior work. This is a mathematical argument with finite numerical corroboration, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform spokes and unit rim edges of finite wheels only, spoke length at least one half, rim-value Euclidean normalization; an unindexed equivalent computation remains possible; infinite claims rest on a complete proof rather than finite tests.
title: A universal contact threshold and curvature jump for weighted-wheel Lipschitz ellipsoids
